text: ロケットだんの　サカキを　たおしたのは　…　きみか！

structure.jp: ロケットだんの　サカキを　たおしたのは
structure.en: the one who beat Team Rocket's Giovanni

patterns.name: 〜のは〜だ
patterns.span: たおしたのは　…　きみか
patterns.explanation: Putting のは after a verb and the key word at the end shines a spotlight on that word: 'the one who did it is X'. たおしたのは　きみか = 'the one who beat him was you!'

patterns.name: 〜か (realization)
patterns.explanation: か here is not a real question; it shows the speaker has just realized something. きみか = 'so it's you!'
